name: The Bike Yard - WhatsApp Customer Assistant (TEST MVP)

parameters.query: INSERT INTO processed_messages(message_id,wa_id) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT (message_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING message_id;
INSERT INTO wa_conversations(wa_id,last_message_at) VALUES ($1,NOW()) ON CONFLICT (wa_id) DO UPDATE SET last_message_at=NOW(),updated_at=NOW() RETURNING wa_id,mode;

parameters.jsCode: const p = $('Parse Text + Test Guard + Intent').item.json; const mode = $json.mode || 'ACTIVE'; if (p.intent === 'OPT_OUT') return [{json:{...p,route:'OPT_OUT'}}]; if (mode === 'OPTED_OUT') return [{json:{...p,route:'SUPPRESS'}}]; if (mode === 'HUMAN_TAKEOVER' || p.intent === 'HUMAN_REQUEST') return [{json:{...p,route:'HUMAN'}}]; return [{json:{...p,route:'AI'}}];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ {messaging_product:'whatsapp',to:$('Conversation Policy Router').item.json.waId,type:'text',text:{preview_url:false,body:'You have been opted out of automated messages from The Bike Yard. We will not send further automated messages.'}} }}

parameters.query: WITH upd AS (UPDATE wa_conversations SET mode='HUMAN_TAKEOVER',updated_at=NOW() WHERE wa_id=$1 RETURNING wa_id), lead AS (INSERT INTO wa_leads(wa_id,intent,customer_message_id,status,notes) SELECT wa_id,$2,$3,'CONFIRM_WITH_STAFF','Human handover requested; staff must respond' FROM upd RETURNING wa_id) INSERT INTO wa_messages(message_id,wa_id,direction,message_type,intent,status,body_text) SELECT $3,wa_id,'IN','text',$2,'STORED_FOR_STAFF',$4 FROM lead;

WITH lead AS (INSERT INTO wa_leads(wa_id,intent,customer_message_id,status,notes) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,'CONFIRM_WITH_STAFF','Captured by assistant; showroom staff must confirm') RETURNING wa_id) INSERT INTO wa_messages(message_id,wa_id,direction,message_type,intent,status) SELECT $3,$1,'IN','text',$2,'RECEIVED' FROM lead;

parameters.jsCode: const req = $('Build Grounded AI Prompt').item.json; const content = $json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content; const reply = typeof content === 'string' && content.trim() ? content.trim().slice(0,1200) : 'Thanks for contacting The Bike Yard. I cannot verify that detail right now. Our showroom team will need to confirm it. Would you like a callback?'; return [{json:{waId:req.waId,intent:req.intent,reply}}];

parameters.content: TEST ONLY. This is a standalone alternative to the existing backend WhatsApp webhook. Do not activate both against the same Meta callback. The current backend already validates Meta signatures and owns conversation processing. Configure PostgreSQL + HTTP credentials/environment before testing. HMAC signature validation must happen at a trusted gateway before this workflow.
